subject.title: fix(discord): retry reply session init conflicts to prevent silent message loss

question: Should Discord retain this bounded channel-level retry as defense in depth if the shared reply-session self-heal in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920 lands?
rationale: Both PRs recover the same named conflict at different owner layers; the code evidence supports each mechanism, but only maintainers can decide whether layered recovery is intentional policy or duplicate behavior.

options.title: Shared recovery plus narrow retry
options.body: Use shared lifecycle self-heal as canonical and retain this bounded abort-aware Discord retry for transient transport-level races.

options.title: Shared recovery only
options.body: Land the shared self-heal and remove or close the Discord-specific retry to keep a single recovery policy.

recommendation.title: Shared recovery plus narrow retry
recommendation.body: Use shared lifecycle self-heal as canonical and retain this bounded abort-aware Discord retry for transient transport-level races.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person to both the Discord handler and shared session lifecycle, and the PR timeline shows direct review assignment.
